requirements: Sparse deterministic plains/desert villages, varied local building floors.
Untouched unoccupied surface/vegetation and underground strata; local foundations only.
Street/door transitions, sealed irrigation, chests/residents/golems on actual surfaces.
Matching cached and uncached chunks, negative coordinates and saved edits.
Generation 1/2 saves preserved; generation 3 roundtrip; unknown generations rejected.
Hand grenade kills exposed villager at 3m, wounds at 5m and does not damage at 7m.
Walls, armor, creative immunity, crater radius and M79/C4 profiles preserved.
limits: A new world is required for terrain-adapted villages; existing worlds stay intact.
No long manual session or second-PC/GPU test.
